{{Quote|Captain, help me and Riggs finish this Roba steak, I don't want to see a fine cut of meat go to waste.|[[Viidu]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Roba steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|filet]] made from [[Roba/Legends|Roba]] on [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. The head of [[Rendia Freight]], [[Viidu]] once ate one with [[Corso Riggs]] and [[Voidhound|Ace]].
